claim: The Portugal store locator still lists two stores that Google Maps marks permanently closed: Loures LoureShopping (Av. das Descobertas 90, store 07708; last Google review 2024-03-26) and Rio Tinto Parque Nascente (store 07718; last review 2023-05-10). Both closures predate the deal, and the locator keeps showing them as stores.
data_point: Live PT sitemap = 9 store IDs (not the 11 the scraper said), 2 of which are long-closed: about 7 of the listed stores are really trading. Both closures are pre-deal; this is a method caveat, not a new closure.
source_name: stores.footlocker.pt sitemap vs Google Maps (Apify compass/crawler-google-places dataset i6xTaFbRCfTge1tqE)
verifier_note: I fetched the live PT sitemap on 2026-10-07: 9 unique IDs, including 07708 (avenida-das-descobertas-n.90) and 07718 (praceta-parque-nascente-35). The scraper's Apify dataset shows both places permanentlyClosed=true, with newest reviews 2024-03-26 and 2023-05-10. Correction: the scraper's 11 listed vs 9 open is wrong, because the sitemap holds 9; its 9 open on Maps includes stores the sitemap lacks (e.g. MarShopping, Riosul), so the two bases do not reconcile. A closed pin could also be a relocated or duplicate listing inside the same mall. I could not run an independent Maps check (Apify monthly limit hit). Not a duplicate: D_w1_locator-census-west-11 makes the general point that the locator lags, but does not name Loures or Rio Tinto. Downgraded to C: pre-deal, method caveat only.

claim: AGAINST: Czech retail magazine Stores 01/2026 (published Apr-2026) lists Foot Locker among the newly opened stores at EUROPARK Praha-Sterboholy. The CZ locator shows the store (13452, EUROPARK SC).
data_point: 1 new CEE door at a Prague mall that is 98.3% let; opening reported Apr-2026, exact date unknown (could predate the 2025-09-08 deal)
original_quote: Mezi nově otevřené obchody patří Foot Locker, Pompo, FANN Parfumérie, Tchibo a asijské potraviny Amart.
english_translation: Among the newly opened stores are Foot Locker, Pompo, FANN Parfumerie, Tchibo and the Asian grocer Amart.
verifier_note: I downloaded the 11-page PDF (Last-Modified 2026-04-13) and found the quote verbatim on p.3, in a EUROPARK article quoting centre director Libor Pospisil. Live CZ sitemap (2026-10-07): 9 unique IDs (the scraper said 10), including europark-sc-80_31_13452. The opening date is not given, so it may predate the deal or be a relocation. No other confirmed file mentions it. Downgraded to C: one small door with an unknown date.
